d.title: Machi Gurumi no Wana: Hakudaku ni Mamireta Shitai
d.jp: 町ぐるみの罠～白濁にまみれた肢体～
d.synopsis: Lewd eyes from all directions... Atsuko has just moved to a town to work as a teacher. She looks forward to her new life there, but what awaits her is... Yes, she gradually gets involved in a storm of sexual assaults planned by the everyone in town...
